prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you referred to soccer as 'football' in a public establishment. Respond to the committee.
response:
*adjusts tie nervously, leans into the microphone*

Mr. Chairman, distinguished members of the committee...

I stand before you today as a patriot. A grill-owner. A man who has personally seared no fewer than four hundred hamburgers this fiscal year alone.

*shuffles papers*

Now. It has been ALLEGED — and I use that word deliberately — that I referred to a certain sport played with the feet as "football." I would remind this committee that I am protected under the Fifth Amendment, the Second Amendment, and the sacred Ninth Amendment right to Ranch Dressing.

*points dramatically*

But I will not hide behind technicalities! I demand you produce your evidence. Was I under the influence of an international friend at the time? Perhaps. Had I recently watched a match involving men in short shorts? Possibly. Does that make me un-American?

*voice rising*

I say to you: I have a POOL. I own a leaf blower. My cooler contains domestic light beer and NOTHING ELSE. When the anthem plays, I place my hand upon my heart AND my spatula.

*softening*

And yes. Yes, I said "football." But I ask you — I BEG you — consider the context. I was cornered. Surrounded. A soccer mom was watching. What was I supposed to say? "Soccer" and blow my cover as a man of the world?

*slams table*

I would rather be indicted than be BORING at a barbecue, sir!

*sits down, wipes brow*

I yield the remainder of my time to the potato salad.
